title: Work–life balance — band 7.0 anchor
notes: Anchor sample labelled 7.0; regression must not drift to 8.5 (direction check).

turns.text: How do you manage your time between work and study?
I block my calendar in advance. On weekdays I finish the most demanding tasks before lunch, and I keep evenings for reading or language practice so I do not mix contexts.
Do you think remote work makes balance easier?
It can, provided people set boundaries. Without a commute I gain an hour, but if I answer messages late at night the line between rest and work disappears.
What advice would you give to someone who feels overwhelmed?
I would suggest choosing two priorities for the day rather than a long list. Once those are done, smaller tasks feel less intimidating, and you still protect time for sleep.
